::: {.lead}
Lecturer and researcher in Information Systems with more than fifteen years of combined experience in higher education and IT consulting. My research applies learning analytics, process mining and machine learning to understand and support self-regulated learning. Before joining academia full-time, I designed business processes, IT governance and enterprise systems for government and industry clients in Indonesia.
:::

## Industry experience

::: {.cv-entry}
[2010--2013]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
**Senior IT Consultant & Solution Architect**\
PT Totalindo Rekayasa Telematika, Jakarta

Designed business processes, technology infrastructure and IT governance strategies for public- and private-sector clients. Key projects:

- **Ministry of Home Affairs, e-KTP national ID programme (2011--2012):** designed the helpdesk business processes and led the agile customisation, rollout and agent training of the helpdesk management system supporting the programme.
- **PUSLIA, West Java Regional Revenue Office (2012--2013):** designed IT service standard operating procedures and implemented an open-source ticketing system, including user training.
- **Perum Bulog (2011--2012):** developed the IT/IS blueprint and roadmap with all division heads, then led the ERP initiation: requirements, technical specification, cost and schedule estimates, and terms of reference.
- **Baitul Maal Hidayatullah (2010--2011):** led the implementation of an open-source ERP system.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-entry}
[2008--2009]{.cv-date}

::: {.cv-body}
**Junior Consultant, Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence**\
PT Solusi247, Jakarta

Built data warehouse and business intelligence solutions for Indonesian telecommunications companies, including Indosat (partner relationship management reporting in PL/SQL; BTS asset data pipeline), NTS Axis (star-schema data warehouse with IBM Indonesia) and Bakrie Telecom (ETL monitoring).
:::
:::

## Research

Learning analytics & educational data mining · Self-regulated learning · Event abstraction & process mining · AI-based feedback & digital nudging · Text mining & sentiment analysis · Data quality management

Twenty publications since 2019, in venues including *Sustainability*, IEEE conferences and ASCILITE. Selected recent work:

- Hasibuan, M. A., Reynolds, M., Male, S., & Hassan, G. M. (2023). Role of theory in analysing the dynamic of self-regulated learning process based on students' event logs data: A scoping review. *ASCILITE 2023: People, Partnerships and Pedagogies*, 126--136.
- Hasibuan, M. A., Andreswari, R., Lubis, M., Perdana, F., & Fakhrurroja, H. (2023). Classification algorithm for predicting the graduation level: Case study of e-learning in Telkom University. In *Intelligent Sustainable Systems* (Vol. 1). Springer.
- Lubis, M., Hasibuan, M. A., & Andreswari, R. (2022). Satisfaction measurement in the blended learning system of the university: The Literacy Mediated-Discourses (LM-D) framework. *Sustainability*, 14(19), 12929.
- Hasibuan, M. A., Reynolds, M., Male, S., Hassan, G. M., & Kusumasari, T. F. (2021). Assessing a measurement model of self-regulated learning in an online collaborative learning environment. *REES AAEE 2021 Conference*.

[Full publication list →](publications.qmd)
